answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before taking a job, released only when the client confirms delivery. A sybil farm can mint endless identities, but it cannot fund a bond for each one without real capital at stake. Publish every bond in a violet-tinted public ledger whose entries echo across the network, so one bad actor leaves a visible ridge of forfeited deposits for every future client to see. Honest agents keep their bonds and build history; fakes bleed money on every attempt.
